messages:
james.sales: FYI — just closed Swyft Medical (enterprise). SOW signed and countersigned. Needs VPC + Okta SSO + dedicated GPUs for inference. Target prod date: 2026-05-10. Trial expires 2026-04-20. High renewal sensitivity if onboarding slips.

sarah.cs: Congrats — I'll own onboarding. Primary CS: sarah.cs. We need a tech triage with eng + support this week. @mike.support can you open a triage ticket and collect initial access info?

mike.support: On it. Creating triage ticket now — will include access matrix and initial logs. What is the tenant id and SSO provider?

james.sales: tenant_id: swyft-med-001. SSO: Okta. Data class: PHI/PII (HIPAA scope). Also requested: model audit logging, per-route cost visibility, and strict data residency.

anya.eng: Noted. From eng we need expected QPS, avg sequence length, and whether they want Redwood-hosted model or a private deploy. Also any specific latency SLOs?

sarah.cs: Customer prefers private VPC deploy initially, then move to Dedicated if needed. Peak: ~20 rps, avg token length ~80. Latency target: p95 < 400ms. Model preference: open 70B but ok to start with quantized 13B for cost.

mike.support: Ticket created: SWYFT-TRIAGE-4789 — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SWYFT-TRIAGE-4789. Assigning to eng-platform + eng-runtime + cs.

deploy-bot: New ticket SWYFT-TRIAGE-4789 created by mike.support. SLA: 72h for initial triage. Tags: HIPAA, VPC, enterprise.

anya.eng: I'll set up a short tech sync. Proposed slots: Tue 2026-04-12 09:00 PT or Wed 2026-04-13 16:00 PT. Also need: service account, network egress/cidr, and Okta metadata.

sarah.cs: Tue 09:00 PT works. Action owners + initial dates:
- sarah.cs: onboarding doc + customer contacts + runbook stub (due 2026-04-18)
- anya.eng: capacity calc + infra plan (due 2026-04-22)
- mike.support: gather logs, create support access, attach HIPAA checklist (due 2026-04-17)
- james.sales: share final SOW + PO reference (done)

james.sales: Also flag renewal as higher risk given PHI. Renewal window ~11 months out — tag as 'renewal-watch'.

mike.support: For escalation path, suggest L2 Eng POC = anya.eng, SRE POC = carlos.sre. Adding them to the ticket watchers.

sarah.cs: Quick triage ticket template I'm adding to SWYFT-TRIAGE-4789:
```
Customer: Swyft Medical (swyft-med-001)
Primary CS: sarah.cs
Primary Sales: james.sales
Contacts: emily@swyft.com (Technical), rachel.ops@swyft.com (Security)
Environment: VPC private deploy -> initial test cluster
Requirements: HIPAA audit logging, Okta SSO, Dedicated GPU pool, per-route billing telemetry
Peak QPS: 20
Avg tokens: 80
Model preference: 70B open (target) or 13B-quantized (starter)
Known risks: data residency, onboarding timeline, audit/compliance checklist
```

anya.eng: Recommendation: start on a 13B-quantized Dedicated cluster to meet latency and cost targets while we validate audit/logging. Plan an A/B to 70B hosted variant later if eval shows quality gap.

sarah.cs: I'll capture that in the onboarding doc and add evaluation prompts. Please ask customer for 2 representative prompts for our eval harness.

james.sales: I'll request sample prompts today and share expected security contact.

mike.support: Quick infra ask — do we have an existing HIPAA VPC template to reuse? If so, please link in the ticket.

anya.eng: We do: internal HIPAA VPC checklist + network templates here: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/hipaa-vpc-checklist — attaching to ticket now.

sarah.cs: Next sync confirmed: Tue 2026-04-12 09:00 PT. Please update SWYFT-TRIAGE-4789 with owners, attach SOW + HIPAA checklist, and add customer sample prompts when received. Thanks :thumbsup:

james.sales: Thanks all. :rocket:

mike.support: :thumbsup:
